DECLARATION . FILED BY PLAINTIFF ROLLINS, CHRISTOPHER

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-09-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-09-2022 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF CHRISTOPHER ROLLINS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT KEVIN GIBBS IS PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-09-2022 - JUDGMENT. (PREVIOUSLY TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ROLLINS, CHRISTOPHER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GIBBS, KEVIN $3,200.00 PRINCIPAL, $125.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,325.00, PLAINTIFF IS RESPONSIBLE FOR JANUARY 2022 RENT BASED ON THE LEASE - 60 DAY NOTICE REQUIREMENT. THE COURT AWARDS NOVEMBER 2021 RENT RETURNED ($1,200.00) PLUS ONE TIME VIOLATION OF CC1942 FOR ENTERING AND USING PLAINTIFF'S ROOM, CLOSET, BED WHEN PLAINTIFF WAS ABSENT FROM HIS ROOM ($2,000.00) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,600.00 FILED BY ROLLINS, CHRISTOPHER AS TO DEFENDANT GIBBS, KEVIN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-09-2022 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
